$sources: KDS 41 17 00:2019 3.2, Table 3.2-1 (seismic importance classes special, I, II and the importance factors 1.5, 1.2, 1.0)
source: KDS 41 17 00:2019: importance class special (I = 1.5), I (1.2) and II (1.0). The categories I-IV are SAEngine's slots: I and II take class II, III class I, IV class special. The wind importance stays 1.0 (the base pack's ASCE 7 method; KDS 41 12 00's importance factor of the wind is not set, VERIFY.md K3).

I.description: Importance class II: buildings of low occupancy (I = 1.0)

II.description: Importance class II: buildings not in the classes special or I (I = 1.0)

III.description: Importance class I: buildings with many occupants (assembly, schools, large buildings) (I = 1.2)

IV.description: Importance class special: essential facilities (hospitals, fire and police stations, emergency facilities) and hazardous facilities (I = 1.5)
